title: The Villa of the Mysteries
sentences: Just outside Pompeii's walls, one villa holds paintings no one has fully explained.
It's called the Villa of the Mysteries, and it was uncovered starting in 1909.
One room is wrapped in a fresco of twenty-nine nearly life-size figures on deep red.
Many scholars think it shows a woman being initiated into the secret cult of Bacchus.
Others see a bride preparing for marriage, or simply scenes from myth.
After two thousand years, there's still no agreement.
